title: Context menu does not dodge panel that's in Auto-Hide mode like it does in Always Visible mode
line: Right-clicking an auto-hide panel now opens the context menu beside the panel instead of on top of it.
explanation: ContainmentItem::contextMenuEvent only clamped panel context menus to the screen's available geometry. Always-visible panels reserve their space, so that kept the menu outside them, but auto-hide (and dodge-windows) panels reserve nothing, so the menu opened at the click point, on top of the panel and its widgets. The change also moves the menu past the panel's own visible rectangle on the side facing the screen centre, according to the panel's edge.

commits.message:
plasmaquick: open panel context menus outside auto-hide panels

Context menus of panels were only kept inside the screen's available
area, which excludes always-visible panels but not auto-hide ones, so
the menu covered the panel; now the menu is also moved past the panel.

BUG: 510908

media.caption: Left auto-hide panel, right-click on the task manager's empty area: the menu covers half the panel
Same right-click with the fix: the menu opens right beside the panel
Right-click on the Application Launcher: the menu covers the launcher and the icons below
Same right-click with the fix: the menu opens beside the panel

reviews.text: Solid fix in libplasma that moves panel context menus outside the panel's actual visual rect along the screen-facing edge, fixing auto-hide and other non-strut panels (and incidentally avoiding the floating-panel margin overlap for these menus). Coordinate handling via mapRectToScene(boundingRect()).toAlignedRect().translated(window()->position()) matches event->globalPosition() on Wayland and fractional scaling, and before/after screenshots clearly verify the fix. Minor metadata nitpick: entry.json's explanation mentions ContainmentItem::contextMenuEvent instead of ContainmentItem::mousePressEvent, though the git commit message itself is accurate.
